---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (USD millions)")
plt.title("James Bond Worldwide Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()
```

The first James Bond film in this dataset was released in `{{ int(bond["year"].min()) }}`, and the last was released in `{{ int(bond["year"].max()) }}`.
